worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.summary: The user casts an angelic, cone-shaped voice field in front of it: enemies inside take special damage, and any target currently carrying positive stat stages is dazed by the song and left confused, so its actions may be wasted and its own force turns on it when it lands a hit. The more it raised, the longer the confusion.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.use.0: Punish an opponent that just powered up and throw off its tempo
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.use.1: Sweep a line of enemies standing in front of the user
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.use.2: Sing a set-up sweeper apart before it can commit
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.descript: It opens a voice field %1$s blocks long with a %2$s degree spread, and every enemy caught in it takes %3$s special damage.

A target carrying positive stages is confused at once, for a base of %1$s plus %2$s for each positive stage; while confused each action it attempts has a %3$s chance to be wasted, and a landed hit turns its own force back on it.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.echo.on: Echo form: a wider, longer field and a longer confusion, but a lighter hit with a slower wind-up and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.echo.off: Direct form: a narrower field that hits harder and faster, but the confusion is shorter.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.growth.0: From level %1$s the song power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.growth.1: From level %1$s it rises again to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.alluringvoice.preferen: On (Echo): spread x1.35, field length x1.1, confusion duration x1.4, wind-up +3 ticks and a longer cooldown, but power x0.85 — good for catching a ring of enemies at once. Off (Direct): a narrower field that hits harder and faster with a shorter confusion, good for locking onto one target.
The partner only considers the song while a threat is this close; larger lets it strike first from farther out.
Once a target's positive stages add up to this much, the song rises above ordinary combat priority; set 1 to sing at any hint of a boost, higher to wait until it has piled up.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to cast this voice field.
